snippet.title: Bottom Squad - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Bottom Squad is an idle defense game at the bottom of your screen. Build your squad, upgrade your base, and hold the line against relentless alien waves while you work or browse.

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4068360/Bottom_Squad/

About Family Devs:

Family Devs is an indie game development studio based in Barcelona, Spain. Family Devs develops and publishes indie games for all platforms. The company consists of a father and sons, all of whom are passionate gamers. For more information visit our website: https://familydevs.com/
